Senses.Explanation: Fond of the child, one fails to see the ugliness turns parental partiality into a Chan appraisal. Speakers apply it when a founder, teacher, or commentator protects, prolongs, or explains a move so fondly that its fault is no longer faced without favor. Chonghua Neng applies it to Shakyamuni’s flower and pairs it with a separate cutting verdict on Mahakasyapa’s smile. Dahui Zonggao builds it into a departure verse; Tianyin Yuanxiu uses it on Mazu’s further examination of Baizhang. Juelang Daosheng names his own exhaustive explanation with the phrase, while Feiyin Tongrong explicitly tells the assembly not to classify their present meeting that way.
